query:
SELECT 
  e.id, 
  e.description, 
  e.amount, 
  e.issueDate, 
  e.entryDate, 
  e.competenceMonth,
  e.managementAccountId,
  ma.code as managementCode,
  ma.name as managementName,
  ma.chartAccountId
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN managementAccounts ma ON e.managementAccountId = ma.id
WHERE e.competenceMonth = '2026-02'
ORDER BY e.entryDate DESC
LIMIT 20;
